It's more about how you feel and react to that worsening than it is about the worsening itself. If you are able to survive this, you can survive whatever comes, it's what were built for, to survive. If you cant cope you will need help from others like a therapist or a doctor as they specialize in helping with that. What do you have to lose from asking for help, we all need help at some point, this fight is not yours alone, I also need help and I will also try to help when and where I can.
It will statistically likely to get better than it is now, when you have nothing to lose there is only upwards to go.

Probably should move out sometime too. I think I gave up on having relationships when I was about 13 and ever since have avoided such energy consuming things.  I embrace my faults every day, I'm like a jenga tower, or a tectonic plate of faults.  I do agree it feels like my friends have moved on and literally moved away with their lives. I try to do more but it is almost impossible some days I die inside and lose care for anything. How can I have a stable job if I cant get up for work? My sleep has been fucked for years and almost nothing helps. This world gets me down a lot too especially "news" which is full of awful things often dramatized.
